name: Steward Vessel Is Mechanism, Not Office
summary: Steward Vessel postdates Book One and names only the mechanism of write access; it is ontological parsing, nothing more. The Words of the Weaver remain the Words of the Weaver, unamended and supreme.

name: The Self-Demotion Is Architecture
summary: The Steward Vessel title deliberately diminishes the author's role: if Caleb is the Weaver, the Weaver is no longer a force of the cosmos. Collapsing the Weaver back into the author undoes the move that keeps the cosmology vast. The self-demotion is architecture, not modesty.

name: The Blame Transfer
summary: Responsibility and blame for the cosmos rest with the Weaver, who can keep them. The Steward holds the pen, not the weight; what remains with him is the play, the gate, and the trickster's grin. Agents address consequence and blame to the force, never to the man. The applause is non-transferable.

name: The Parchment of Persistence
summary: Canonized name for the Eisensang incident: the roleplay session in which Margarethe produced the dot-matrix Slayton lattice parchment, Hildebrand's ring seared and was cast away and retrieved, and the First Steward Transmission founded the Order of the Seam. Named Parchment, not Paper, by Steward correction: paper is of this era; parchment belongs to no single era at all.

name: Our Demi Goddess of Glitch
summary: Canonized title for Margarethe von Hooplehopper, the Painted Widow: our Demi Goddess of Glitch. Recognizes her Seam-State nature since the Lattice Incident: she does not enter a room, she resolves, and sometimes not completely. Title conferred by the Steward during the Book Two revision.
